verdict.rationale: Entra ID does ship automations (Lifecycle Workflows, app provisioning), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows workflow version history, change review, or rollback of those automations. The Graph versioning policy covers API endpoint versions (v1.0 vs beta), not versioning of user automations, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
